ligand_check.method: Element census plus attempted neutral RDKit DetermineBonds(charge=0, embedChiral=True); inference failed, so no independent stereochemical match was established. No bond orders or coordinates were forced.
ligand_check.limitation: Element census supports maintainer pNPG assignment. If inference fails, stereochemistry remains independently unconfirmed; no bond orders or coordinates were forced to match. Not proof of experimental occupancy, provenance or a new crystal structure.

rigid_alignment_method: Proper Kabsch row-vector fit via NumPy SVD; determinant +1. Conservative compatibility thresholds RMSD <=0.002 A and max displacement <=0.004 A for input PDB coordinates rounded to 0.001 A. Larger residuals indicate internal differences, not a processing history.
scope: Structure inspection only; no prepared scan input, RANA scan, relaxation, residue filling, output renumbering or experimental analysis.

source_locators.coordinate_identity_sequence_atoms_and_c: Named candidate PDB: ATOM/HETATM columns; observed residues deduplicated by chain, author residue number, insertion code. Method in methods.md.
source_locators.full_RCSB_polymer_sequences: 2JIE.cif / 2O9P.cif: _entity_poly.pdbx_seq_one_letter_code_can; these are 454-residue constructs, not 445-residue coordinate sequences.
source_locators.public_standard_sequence: d2d_sequence.html <big> element, compared exactly with P22505.json sequence.value (448 residues).
source_locators.D2D_full_construct: Not declared in the PDB; left null. A 448-residue public reference sequence is not a declaration of the supplied construct.
source_locators.mutations: 2O9P.cif _struct_ref_seq_dif rows with details=engineered mutation: pdbx_auth_seq_num=376/377, db_mon_id=HIS/GLY, mon_id=GLN/ARG; independently checked coordinate sequence against P22505.
source_locators.functional_site_mapping: Maintainer list; d2d_sequence.html anchor title attributes Rosetta/Foldit and PDB; observed PDB identities; P22505.json features for catalytic roles and original ECO evidence codes.
source_locators.atom_comparisons: Computed from the three hashed PDBs after sequence-based identity matching; proper Kabsch fit and CA distance-invariance check; no input coordinate changes.
source_locators.ligand_composition: Standard_D2D_BglB_WT.pdb HETATM LG1 X:1: 12 C, 15 H, 1 N, 8 O; claimed identity from maintainer. CCD PNW is a chemical reference, not an automatic renaming of LG1.
